title: John Mack's death in a car crash; Sheehan looked into it

tellings.quote: Yeah, I was on that within hours after it happened, you know, dug it out and knew who the guy was. The guy still in prison that that ran him down. He was just drunk and uh

plain: The psychiatrist John Mack was killed in 2004 when a car ran him down, and a lawyer named Dan Sheehan says he looked into the death within hours of it happening. Sheehan says he dug into it and found out who the driver was, a man he says is still in prison and who, by his account, "was just drunk". That answers, in his view, the question of whether there was anything more behind the death.
